title: Reading Drill — Monitoring fruit in cold storage — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Monitoring fruit in cold storage — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The store manager in Bramley received an old report about fruit ripening unevenly inside the same room. The report compared fruit firmness, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the pressure readings rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered ten weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include different delivery dates. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed shorter stacked rows as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
